guidelines.description: HHS poverty guidelines in dollars per year, one row per year x state group x household size (the adapter makes one API call per combination and checks that the API answered the combination asked for).

year.desc: guideline year 1983 to the current year: one year, a list, or a range "2020-2026"

state.desc: us (48 contiguous states and DC), ak (Alaska), hi (Hawaii), a list of them, or all

household_size.desc: persons in the household 1 to 20: one size, a list, or a range "1-8" (sizes 9 to 20 are computed by the API as the size-8 guideline plus the per-person increment)
